name: Hau nuong pho mai
summary: Hàu nướng phô mai is oysters grilled with cheese on Đầm Lập An. Nhân Dân says rock oysters are favored this way. VietnamPlus names the same plate.
origin: Lang Co, on Đầm Lập An. Nhân Dân, 5 July 2024, and VietnamPlus, 9 February 2016.
texture: Nhân Dân’s cook says hàu đá is firmer and more strongly fragrant than hàu sữa, and that rock oysters are the ones favored for cheese.
howToEat: Eat it on the lagoon. Neither article names a shop or the cheese.
A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Đầm Lập An. No door is named.
